## Design

### 2026-11-08: I started to design the main arm body and blade mechanic in CAD until i got a design i liked. I measured out my arm to make sure it'd fit and created a mechanism to let the blade pivot using two servo

**4h**

I started to design the main arm body and blade mechanic in CAD until i got a design i liked. I measured out my arm to make sure it'd fit and created a mechanism to let the blade pivot using two servo motors and extend outwards

### 2026-11-08: I worked on the arm mechanism and how it extends, using two arms to allow the blade to extend and contract. This is a simpler version of the in-game blades but I found that this was better than trying

**3h**

I worked on the arm mechanism and how it extends, using two arms to allow the blade to extend and contract. This is a simpler version of the in-game blades but I found that this was better than trying to recreate the design verbatim as it would require multiple motors to properly extend

### 2026-11-08: Doing some research, I have settled on two MG90Ss for the servo motors which will connect to an esp 32 mounted on the body, controlled by a joystick that you hold in your hand to extend and release to

**1.5h**

Doing some research, I have settled on two MG90Ss for the servo motors which will connect to an esp 32 mounted on the body, controlled by a joystick that you hold in your hand to extend and release to contract.

### 2026-11-08: I sketched out the wiring layout to finish up my project. Originally I was planning on using a custom pcb but since i'll need wires to connect the motor regardless, I figured it'd be easier to just us

**3h**

I sketched out the wiring layout to finish up my project. Originally I was planning on using a custom pcb but since i'll need wires to connect the motor regardless, I figured it'd be easier to just use a breadboard instead. I played around with pcb model in KiCAD but eventually decided against it. I also refined the blade model in CAD before settling on a design I am happy with.
